title: Why Standard Shoes Fit Fewer British Feet
hook: Feet grew longer and wider while more bodies carried extra weight.
closing: Shoe labels stayed simple while British feet changed in three different ways.
question: Has your shoe size changed?

segments.say: Average British men's shoes reached size 10. Standard sizing now has to fit feet longer than the previous generation's.
Sixty-seven percent of women report wider adult feet. Length alone no longer explains why familiar shoes feel wrong.
Sixty-six percent of adults in England are overweight or obese. More body weight adds another fit pressure without proving one cause.
